degraded_gaps.description: User-proposed Domain Plane target data omits required section-7 fields: upstream_dependencies, optional_inputs, forbidden_inputs, handoff_outputs, runner_binding_status, state_writeback_required, paper_only_required, real_trade_allowed. Executable YAML fills explicit defaults.
User-proposed phase_status REQUIRED_BEFORE_DATA_PLANE is not in legal enum; executable YAML normalized to READY_TO_BUILD.
K00/P00/Governance/Domain target instances are now generated; remaining Data Plane, P01-P10 and other planes still need concrete target data instances.
Prior registry/control references used P09 as upgrade; new methodology defines P09 review learning and P10 system upgrade, requiring registry reconciliation before full phase execution.
